summary.intent: Review and land a set of fixes in the callisto repo: parenthesized Python requirement parsing, decision-target path validation, and subdirectory-sibling git handling, then open PRs linked to trail #357.
summary.outcome: Two of three fixes (parenthesized Python requirements, decision-target validation) are implemented on signed-commit branches with lint/pre-push/doc-check/workflow-contracts passing; the subdirectory-sibling fix and changesets are still in progress and no PRs have been opened yet.

repo: Python manifest rewriting lives in crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs and uses a hand-written PEP 508 parser; no crate in Cargo.lock parses PEP 508 requirements (pep440_rs only handles version specifiers).
The `;` environment-marker split must stay first in requirement parsing, before name/extras/URL parsing.
`Requirement` now carries a `parenthesized` flag so rewrites preserve the user's `lib-py (==x)` form; `name[extra] @ url` keeps the URL out of extras.

A shared helper validates decision targets for `version --emit-decision`, `release plan --decision` and `release pending --decision`; errors E225 (outside workspace) and E226 (root, existing dir, trailing separator, under .git, unresolvable) exit 2 with nothing written, and symlink escapes via relative paths are caught.
CI-style gates in this repo: `pre-push`, `lint`, `doc-check`, `workflow-contracts`, and `just test`, which has one known environment-related failure.
Proptest on the parser runs at 20,000 cases and caught a `"("` edge case.

code.finding: Parser name now terminates at whitespace, `(`, `[`, `@`, `,` or an operator; text after the name that is not a clause is dropped, which was the reviewed risk for silent rewrites.

workflow: Reproduce the bug first, then write tests that fail before the fix (3 of 4 decision-target reject tests failed pre-fix; the 4th is a passing guard).
Fan work out to parallel agents (parser fix, decision-target fix, subdirectory siblings, changesets) and review their diffs before accepting.
Use `git diff origin/main...origin/<branch>` to review remote branches without checking them out.

friction: An existing test depended on a file-as-parent failing late; it had to be rewritten to use a read-only directory and is now unix-only.
`just test` still ends with a known environment failure that must be discounted each run.
open_items: Subdirectory siblings fix is still running: `--relative` for the release-commit shape check, the E121 guard, and a sweep of every other git call.
Changesets for the two finished branches are still being written by the courier agent.
Link each branch to trail #357, open PRs and edit the bodies.
Confirm that silently dropping non-clause text after the requirement name cannot change a user's dependency line.
